titulo_es: A decision is postponed · Society and various needs

texto: In a public discussion it identifies the groups concerned and the reasons for each position. A proposal is not yet a decision; it observes verbs such as «foreslår», «beslutter» and «undersøger».
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.da: Beslutningen bliver derfor udsat til næste måned.
frases.es: Por eso la decisión se aplaza hasta el mes siguiente.
frases.en: That is why the decision is postponed until the following month.
